name: io.github.mazeasdamien/rising-shores-singapore
title: Singapore Digital Twin · Sea level rise and live data
description: Sea-level rise in Singapore: when a place or address floods, areas and people affected, IPCC AR6.

tools.name: sea_level
tools.description: Projected sea-level rise at Singapore for a year and an emissions scenario (CCRS V3 2024, Ng et al. 2025, IPCC AR6), in metres above today's high-tide level.

year.description: A year, 2025-2150 (with scenario), instead of rise_m.

scenario.description: moderate = SSP2-4.5, high = SSP5-8.5 (very high emissions), upper = SSP5-8.5 upper range (planning). Default high.

storm_surge.description: Add an extreme storm surge and high tide (+1.3 m) on top.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" English (default), "fr" French, "ms" Malay or "zh" Simplified Chinese.

tools.name: when_does_it_flood
tools.description: In which year each scenario reaches a given sea-level rise (metres above today's high tide), or "beyond 2150".

rise_m.description: Sea-level rise in metres above today's mean high water (0-9).

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" English (default), "fr" French, "ms" Malay or "zh" Simplified Chinese.

tools.name: check_address
tools.description: For a Singapore postal code or place name: the sea-level rise at which it first connects to the sea, and roughly when each scenario gets there.

query.description: A postal code (e.g. 018956) or a place name.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" English (default), "fr" French, "ms" Malay or "zh" Simplified Chinese.

tools.name: live_now
tools.description: What is happening in Singapore right now, from public live feeds a few minutes old: air temperature, wind, rain, lightning, flood alerts in PUB's open data feed (not PUB's flood warnings), the tide (a model), haze, UV, free taxis and planes. Times are Singapore time. Reads the map's own latest snapshot; no forecast.

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" English (default), "fr" French, "ms" Malay or "zh" Simplified Chinese.

tools.name: ships_now
tools.description: Ships near a place in Singapore's waters right now, from Open Waters AIS (volunteer receivers, ODbL): how many, of which kind, moving or still, and the nearest ones with how long ago each was heard. Give a place, or lat and lon. Pleasure craft are never named.

radius_km.description: How far around, in km (default 3, at most 8).

lang.description: Language of the answer: "en" English (default), "fr" French, "ms" Malay or "zh" Simplified Chinese.
